evals.expected_output: Should verify Context7 with resolve-library-id (query and libraryName both required, returns an id like /facebook/react) and Jina with read_url (works without a key, search tools need one)
expectations: The answer verifies Context7 with the resolve-library-id tool
The answer says resolve-library-id needs both query and libraryName
The answer gives a library id such as /facebook/react as the expected Context7 result
The answer verifies Jina with the read_url tool
The answer says read_url works without an API key
The answer says the Jina search tools need a key
